product.title: SL101 3000K Warm White LED Low Voltage Bistro String Lights 48 FT Outdoor Weatherproof 12V Edison Bulbs
product.body_html:
Our SL101 Low Voltage Weatherproof & Heavy-duty led outdoor string lights are commercial grade for both indoor and outdoor use. The insulation material can protect the strand from hot winter, sun, wind, rain, snow, and dampness. Flexible heavy-duty cord withstands the wear of indoor and outdoor use. The First LED 12V String Lights available on the market. SL101-LB2W Replacement Light Bulbs are available also!

Made for a greater mood lighting flexibility and a soft glow to create the perfect atmosphere for a birthday party, family reunion, or wedding reception. It adds flair to bistros, decks, porches, patios, gardens, backyards, terraces, pergolas, cafés, restaurants, and malls. It's ideal for weddings, BBQ parties, banquets, also suitable for tree-lighting like a Christmas tree. Waterproof and Shatterproof with fully sealed and self-gasketed sockets, hanging lights string are sure to stay under the sun, rain, even in the worst weather conditions.

The bulbs are made of plastic so they will not easily break if dropped or blown away by the wind, which will protect your family and friends away from dangerous shards. Ideal Outdoor Lighting as each strand contains twenty E26 low voltage-based waterproof hanging sockets, provided with 2W LED bulbs (40 Watts Total). They illuminate at 3000K Warm White color temperature to give off an aesthetic, warm lighting effect and at 90 lumens per bulb (total 1800 lumens) this Heavy-duty 12V Bistro light is bright enough and ideal illumination for any application. Replacement bulbs can be found here.

The distance between bulbs is approximately 24 inches. 12 inches on each end. Each socket has a hanging hook above, making it easy to hang with hooks, guide wires, or zip ties. It can connect with another simply with the adapters provided on each end of the strands. Link up to 5 strands and connect to your normal AC/DC low voltage landscape lighting system. Used with an AC/DC 12V Transformer to power the lights.

We recommend adding a String Light Hanging Cable Kit as this is best used to fight against heavy winds and to ensure your bistro lights will last long and stay connected. It helps battle against long-term heat which results in drooping and low-hanging lights.

All low voltage outdoor lights must be installed with a 12V Low Voltage Transformer and connections between lights must be secured using Grease Filled Wire Nuts (WN12) waterproof connectors. SL101 bistro light includes a connector that lets you connect it to your transformer.
